name: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiary companies, specializes in the development and distribution of a wide variety of pet food products. Its operations also encompass the import and sale of both pet food and related pet items. The company offers a comprehensive range, including wet and dry food and treats specifically formulated for dogs and cats, with a notable focus on wet cat food crafted from fresh ingredients such as tuna, shrimp, or salmon. Its business is segmented into Pet Food and Other Products. i-Tail markets its offerings under prominent brands like Bellotta, Marvo, ChangeTer, Calico Bay, and Paramount, serving a global market that spans Thailand, the United States, various Asian countries, Oceania, European nations, and other international regions. The company, established in 1981, was previously known as Songkla Canning Public Company Limited before changing to its current name in September 2021. Headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited functions as a subsidiary of Thai Union Group Public Company Limited.
